strategy.name: the condensed front door
strategy.why: Five UK Staffy breeder homepages were read for this board and not one of them names a puppy with a price and a status on the front page. Two are stud-service sites, one shows a photograph strip with no names, one withholds its location until a vetting call, and the fifth keeps its FAQs on another page. Two publish no JSON-LD at all and one has no heading outline at all. A front page that answers what is available, what it costs, what comes with it and who raised it — in that order, with a link to the page that owns each answer — is unclaimed.
strategy.trade_off: Condensing means the homepage argues nothing at length, so it will not rank for the informational breed queries the migrated page chased; those queries are the breed guide's and the health page's, and the homepage's job is to route to them rather than to compete with them.
